params.name: real
params.description: Real value to write into the BLOB.

params.name: blob
params.description: BLOB to receive the Real value; its size is adjusted to fit the written value.

params.name: realFormat
params.description: Internal format/byte-ordering constant for the written value: 0 Native, 1 Extended, 2 Macintosh Double, 3 Windows/PC Double.

params.name: offset
params.description: Byte offset (from zero) within blob at which to write; on return, incremented by the number of bytes written so it can be reused for a subsequent BLOB write.
If passed, append the Real value at the end of blob instead of writing at the start or at offset.

overloads.semanticRole: Writes real into blob in the byte format/ordering selected by realFormat, either at the start of the BLOB, at a caller-supplied offset, or appended at the end.

constraints: New bytes allocated by extending the BLOB (other than the value being written) are zero-initialized.
Does not support blob objects (4D.Blob type); it mutates the classic BLOB parameter in place, so blob must be a legacy BLOB, not a 4D.Blob.
